Details.Name: Retro Runner
Details.Author: Fred Nerk
Details.Description: A retro note strummer style rhythm game. The player must strum the correct notes as they scroll down the screen to the beat of the music. The game features a variety of songs and difficulty levels, as well as a fun and colorful retro aesthetic.

stages.Name: Stage 1
stages.Description: The first stage of the game, featuring a simple song and easy difficulty level.

stages.Name: Stage 2
stages.Description: The second stage of the game, featuring a more complex song and medium difficulty level.

stages.Name: Stage 3
stages.Description: The third stage of the game, featuring a challenging song and hard difficulty level.
